q.description: Parameter defines the query you want to search. You can use anything that you would use in a regular Pinterest search (e.g., `coffee corner ideas`, `wedding dresses`, or `nail art`). To apply an option of `filters` or a related search, search its `query`.

type.description: Parameter defines the type of results to search for, like Pinterest's search filter. It defaults to `pins`. Available options: `pins` - All Pins `videos` - Videos `boards` - Boards `profiles` - Profiles `products` - Products

less_ai.description: Parameter defines whether to show fewer AI-generated and AI-modified pins, like Pinterest's "Less AI" filter. It can be set to `true` or `false` (default).

next_page_token.description: Parameter defines the next page token. It is used for retrieving the next page of results. Up to `25` pins, or up to `50` boards or profiles, are returned per page. The next page token can be found in the SerpApi JSON response: `serpapi_pagination -> next_page_token`. It must be used with the same q, type, and less_ai as the search it comes from.

engine.description: Set parameter to `pinterest` to use the Pinterest API engine.

no_cache.description: Parameter will force SerpApi to fetch the Pinterest results even if a cached version is already present. A cache is served only if the query and all parameters are exactly the same. Cache expires after 1h. Cached searches are free, and are not counted towards your searches per month. It can be set to `false` (default) to allow results from the cache, or `true` to disallow results from the cache. no_cache and async parameters should not be used together.

async.description: Parameter defines the way you want to submit your search to SerpApi. It can be set to `false` (default) to open an HTTP connection and keep it open until you got your search results, or `true` to just submit your search to SerpApi and retrieve them later. In this case, you'll need to use our Searches Archive API to retrieve your results. async and no_cache parameters should not be used together. async should not be used on accounts with Ludicrous Speed enabled.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise only. Parameter enables ZeroTrace mode. It can be set to `false` (default) or `true`. Enable this mode to skip storing search parameters, search files, and search metadata on our servers. This may make debugging more difficult.

api_key.description: Parameter defines the SerpApi private key to use.

output.description: Parameter defines the format of the result. It can be set to `json` (default) to get a structured JSON of the results, `html` to get the raw HTML retrieved, or `md` to get a Markdown-formatted version optimized for LLMs and AI agents.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.
